info.name: List prompt logs for a workspace

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Conversation entity UUID (canonical identifier across all modalities — voice, text/web, sms, sim). Resolves text conversations through the durable ``world.conversations`` row, then falls back to the voice/call entity projection. Mutually exclusive with the ``call_sid`` query parameter.

params.name: call_sid
params.description: Direct conversation identifier as stored on the prompt-log event: Twilio CA-SID for voice calls, session_id UUID for text/sim sessions. Most callers should use ``conversation_id`` instead — this is kept for legacy callers and external systems that hold the SID directly. Mutually exclusive with ``conversation_id``.

params.name: prompt_type
params.description: Filter by prompt_type (e.g. engage_user, navigation, tool)

params.name: state_name
params.description: Filter by HSM state_name at render time

items.docs:
Lists ``prompt_log`` events emitted by agent-engine — full system prompt, conversation history, tool catalog, LLM model, and response — for auditing and debugging. Reads the Delta ``world_events`` ledger via Databricks SQL; typical latency is 1-5s with a 15s ceiling on cold-start.

**Conversation filter**: pass ``conversation_id`` for the canonical mental model. Text conversations resolve from ``world.conversations``; voice/call IDs resolve through the projected conversation entity. ``call_sid``
